scope: Offline structural and deterministic local-evidence checks only

localEvidenceCheck.method: Bundled the existing collectEvidence export in memory with esbuild; called it for all 44 merged inputs with null extraction, an explicit fixed date, and a fetcher that throws on any outbound request.
localEvidenceCheck.limitations: Checks deterministic evidence kind/state compatibility, not model selection, explanation semantics, live directory freshness, HTTP handling or external reputation.
